note: 30-product Phase-0 gold seed. Expected bands derived from first-principles nutrition + physical label (direct product scrape). Independence firewall: no engine score/grade/dimension output was consulted when authoring expected{}. OFF-ban: no Open Food Facts values anywhere. Grade cutoffs: S>=90, A 80-89, B 65-79, C 50-64, D 35-49, E 0-34. Dimensions are advisory only (max 3 per entry, label-observable only). Data-gap entries (A02, A05, A06, A07, A08, A09, A10, P09) resolved from BSIP1 normalized_nutrition_per_100g fields; where null, noted as null with reason.

rubric.criterion: Whole-wheat biscuit 95%; NOVA 2-3; fiber 10g + protein 12g/100g; sugar 4.2g
rubric.rationale: Weetabix: 95% whole wheat, malt extract as only processing marker. High fiber (10g) and protein (12g) at 342 kcal. Sugar 4.2g well below red-label. Malt extract = NOVA-3 marker nudging composite cap to 87 (NOVA_PROXY_3_PROCESSED). Fat 2g, sat_fat 0.6g — no fat penalty. Sodium 110mg — no red label. Expected B because NOVA-3 classification prevents A.

rubric.criterion: 48% whole oats, seeds, nuts; no synthetic additives; protein 12g + fiber 9.4g/100g; sugar 13.5g (below red-label 17.5g)
rubric.rationale: Superfood granola with 48% oats, dates, goji, olive oil. No synthetic additives (whole-food sources only). Strong protein (12g) and fiber (9.4g). Sugar 13.5g from dates/syrups below red-label threshold. Calorie density 410 kcal places it in medium tier for snack_bar_granola archetype. Sat_fat 4.5g just below 5g red-label. Expected B: calorie density holds it from A.

rubric.criterion: White spelt sourdough; fermentation bonus eligible; protein 9g; fiber 3.3g; sodium 366mg (below red-label 600mg)
rubric.rationale: Short ingredient list with genuine sourdough starter (14% whole wheat sourdough). Low fat (1.5g/100g). Ascorbic acid (E300) as only synthetic additive. Sodium 366mg below red-label threshold. Fermentation bonus potentially eligible. Calorie density 248 kcal in favorable bread tier. Boundary B-C because NOVA-3 may fire on the sourdough + enzyme combination.

rubric.criterion: Chickpeas 56%, tahini 17%; 3 additives (stabilizers + potassium sorbate); protein 7.9g; sodium 375mg
rubric.rationale: Standard Israeli retail hummus. Real chickpea (56%) and raw tahini (16.9%). Sugar 1.1g (complex carbs from chickpeas). Sodium 375mg — below red-label 600mg but above shelf median ~390mg (mild shelf-relative penalty). Three additives (guar, xanthan, potassium sorbate) — borderline ADDITIVE_MARKERS_3_PLUS cap (72). Expected B-C with additive count as primary constraint.

rubric.criterion: NOVA-1 low-fat brined cheese; protein 12g at 117 kcal; sodium exactly 600mg (at red-label threshold); one additive (potassium sorbate)
rubric.rationale: Minimally-processed low-fat Tzfatit. Excellent protein density (12g at 117 kcal). Only penalty is sodium at exactly 600mg (graduated sodium BARI_GRAD_SODIUM_V1=on applies; shelf-relative ~below median 1000mg gives relief not surcharge). Under DAIRY_PROTEIN_REWEIGHT_V1 protein weight elevated 10%->14%. Expected B.

rubric.criterion: Three-ingredient whole-food date bar: dates 76%, almond paste 22%, almonds; NOVA-1; zero additives; 92 kcal/100g; sugar 15.5g (below 17.5g red-label)

Protein very low (1.6g) — depresses protein_quality and satiety dimensions. Expected B-C depending on date-sugar glycemic penalty weight.

rubric.rationale: Similar to G-007 (Achla hummus) but with slightly higher sodium (395mg vs 375mg) and unspecified 'shmanim tzimchiyim' (vegetable oils — fat_tech soft concern). Sugar 0.6g. Four additives. Sodium 395mg near shelf median — minimal shelf-relative penalty or near-zero. Marginally weaker than G-007. Expected B-C.

E-471 + E-476 (PGPR) emulsifier identity deltas. HIGH_CAL_HIGH_SUGAR_SEVERE cap (50) and ISRAELI_RED_LABELS_2_PLUS cap (45) stack. Expected D-E.

NOVA-4 with 3+ additives triggers ADDITIVE_MARKERS_3_PLUS cap (72), then NOVA_PROXY_4_ULTRA_PROCESSED cap (68). Low nutrient density severely depresses composite. rubric.rationale: Two red labels: sat_fat 16g (3.2x 5g threshold) and sodium 1010mg (above 700mg hard cap). Under BARI_GRAD_SODIUM_V1=on + BARI_SODIUM_SHELF_RELATIVE_V1=on, graduated + shelf-relative sodium penalties compound. Calorie density 274 kcal (just above 250 threshold for dairy_protein archetype — moves to lower band). DAIRY_PROTEIN_REWEIGHT_V1 partially offsets via elevated protein weight (protein 11g). Expected C-D.

rubric.criterion: ADVERSARIAL — 'Fitness' healthy-halo vs real score: sugar 17.9g/100g is EXACTLY at Israeli red-label threshold (17.5g); cap 55 (ISRAELI_RED_LABEL_1_SUGAR) is a ceiling; calorie density 428 kcal borderline worst tier

Calorie density 428 kcal is just inside the second-worst tier for snack_bar_granola. Sunflower oil present (seed-oil penalty). Glucose syrup + inverted sugar = industrial sweeteners. Consumer expects B given the 'Fitness' brand and whole-grain base. The engine should give C because the red-label cap (55) is a ceiling regardless of fiber/protein.
